Want to suggest a guest?
Ami Ganatra is an IIM Ahmedabad alumna, former management consultant and the bestselling author of Mahabharata Unravelled and Ramayana Unravelled. A student of Sanskrit, she quotes Valmiki shloka by shloka and separates the original text from what films, TV serials and later retellings added. Her new book, Sama, Dama, Danda, Bheda, turns Chanakya's Arthashastra into a working playbook for leadership, power and decision-making. She argues from the source and calls out distortions wherever she finds them.
